name: Samani (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Samani town emblem in white: a comma-shaped (tomoe) swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Samani, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1918.

features.role: Samani town emblem — a comma-shaped (tomoe) swirl
